prompts.prompt: Edit target: supplied night-info game UI reference. Purple nocturnal farm backdrop with silhouettes of trees and a windmill, small starry sky. Close foreground emphasis on monster hands and wooden fence. Rich purple, teal and warm amber hand-painted glossy mobile-game art exactly matching supplied reference. Opaque illustrated background fills entire rectangle; no transparent areas.
